description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amend to the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 2016/28 of  25.04.2017, Kesbewa South, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521205
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing corrections and updates to land parcel registrations, including extent modifications, ownership changes, lease registrations, and expunging of particulars. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and involves detailed land registration matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
